description: Get trade-in value for a vehicle. Requires VIN, mileage, condition tier (excellent/very_good/good/fair), and answers to history questions: original_owner, accidents ('Yes'/'No'/'Not Sure'), insurance_claims, odors, service_records, multiple_keys, rental_car, making_payments. IMPORTANT: this tool CANNOT produce a dollar amount — KBB gates offer generation on our key, so it returns a condition assessment only (tier placement, mileage comparison, history impact). Use it to pre-qualify the vehicle conversationally, then call get_trade_in_link to send the customer to KBB for their actual Instant Cash Offer. Never invent, estimate, or imply a trade-in dollar figure, and do not tell the customer 'the sales team will finalize the value' as if a number already exists — it does not.
name: get_trade_in_value
